integrity: All claims are based on an explicit proof and reproducible finite checks; the same-model assessment is not independent validation, and priority beyond the inspected sources is unresolved.
scientific_limitations: The zero-free bound and sharp growth concern pairs on the first-coordinate axis of the canonical pentablock Hardy kernel; off-axis zeros and general boundary asymptotics are not classified. The elementary reciprocal-binomial generating identity and general Pick criterion are acknowledged as known.
title: The arcsine axial kernel and Pick obstruction for pentablock Hardy space
